metadata.title: fix: display error message on UI when removing admin privileges from a user
metadata.author: marekdano

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #2805 --- ## 📝 Summary When we want to update user details e.g. remove admin privileges from a user in the Edit User modal, the API returns the error `Error updating user: Admin protection is enabled — cannot demote or deactivate any admin user` and the error should be displayed on UI. Errors now display correctly in the Edit User modal --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [x] Bug fix - [ ] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) Implemented complete HTMX error display plumbing for the Edit User form, mirroring the working team edit modal pattern. #### Changes mcpgateway/admin.py - Added error container div `(
)` above the edit user form - Added HTMX targeting attributes to form tag: hx-target="#edit-user-error" hx-swap="innerHTML" tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_admin.py - Added `test_admin_get_user_edit_has_error_display` - Verifies error container and HTMX attributes exist in form HTML - Added `test_admin_update_user_errors_include_retarget_header` - Verifies HX-Retarget headers on generic and admin protection errors #### Testing All tests pass (2 new tests added, both passing). --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | | | Unit tests | `make test` | | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | ✅ | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8759e505-db4d-425b-bc79-63a2f4acd904

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Rebased onto main and fixed two missing error paths.

The `htmx:beforeSwap` handler in `admin.html` only processes 4xx responses when the `HX-Retarget` header is present. The original PR added `HX-Retarget` to 2 of the 4 error paths in `admin_update_user`, which meant:

- **"Passwords do not match"** — silently dropped by HTMX (no visible error)
- **"Password validation failed"** — silently dropped by HTMX (no visible error)

Added `headers={"HX-Retarget": "#edit-user-error"}` to both of these so all 4 error responses now display correctly in the modal.

All 739 admin unit tests pass.
